from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

during=Image.open('.tmp/swipe_seek_during.png').convert('RGB')
post=Image.open('.tmp/swipe_seek_post.png').convert('RGB')
a=np.array(during)
b=np.array(post)
# center region roughly mid vertically 600..900
h,w=a.shape[0],a.shape[1]
# choose middle 300px height around center
y0=h//2-150; y1=h//2+150
mad=np.abs(a[y0:y1,:,:].astype('int32')-b[y0:y1,:,:].astype('int32')).mean()
print('center_region MAD',mad)
PY
